name: Legatum first playable
goal: You and your partner each play on your own computer over the LAN (one Mac hosts) against 6 scripted AIs, with simultaneous turns and a live VP track. One-screen hot-seat is a secondary mode.

stories.title: Workspace and core skeleton
acceptance: Cargo workspace with core, ai, sim, wasm crates
Core types, hex math, RNG, state hash

stories.title: Turn resolution rules
acceptance: Movement rounds with bounce and swap rules
verification: cargo test -p legatum-core rules (one test per rule)

stories.title: Headless simulation runner and determinism
acceptance: Determinism check replays and compares hashes

stories.title: WASM bindings
acceptance: wasm-bindgen API: new game, view, validate, submit orders, AI orders, resolve, forecast, save/load
WASM hash equals native hash for the same game
verification: node smoke test comparing hashes with native

stories.title: Web UI
acceptance: Canvas hex map with pan/zoom and fog
City panel with production and breakdowns
Both human seats plan, then Ready resolves the turn
verification: Browser play-through: found city, build, research, end 10 turns, VP track updates

stories.title: Tauri desktop app
acceptance: Mac .app bundle that runs the web UI
verification: npm run tauri build produces Legatum.app

stories.title: LAN play (two computers)
acceptance: legatum-server hosts the game and serves the UI on the LAN
Each browser joins one seat and sees only its own view
Turn resolves when both humans are Ready
verification: cargo test -p legatum-server (two WebSocket clients play turns)
Browser play-through with two separate clients

stories.title: Balance pass v1
acceptance: No faction wins more than ~20% or less than ~6% of its seats (distinctiveness beats evenness inside that band)
>= 60% of games decided by VP (no default turn limit since the game-speed decision; stalls reported separately)
Median game length 110-150 turns at Quick speed (Standard ~2x, about 300)
Early game feel at Quick: first trained Soldier in 10-14 turns, first Settler in 18-25 (Standard ~2x)
evidence: docs/sim-results/2026-09-27-ai-early-soldier-comparison.md (Quick 1,000 + Standard 500 games: first Soldier median 12 / 23, first Settler 25 / 50, median length 145 / 283, VP-decided 99.8% / 100%, factions 7.0-16.9% / 7.0-19.8%, 1,500/1,500 deterministic)

stories.title: Independent review
verification: Full test suite, sim run and UI play-through re-run after fixes
evidence: .reviews/astra-final-review-{core,server,app}.md and the Claude final review (11 findings); all confirmed findings fixed and merged
Re-run after fixes: cargo test --workspace, 423 vitest, 10/10 Playwright, native/WASM tape check, a 25-turn UI play-through with no console errors
